name: 課題一覧の情報行
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Lighthouse catalog component LH09-0001, 課題一覧の情報行.
Generate ONE high fidelity Japanese task information row using supplied image 1 as the exact content and layout reference. Image 2 is the original Linear crop for information anatomy only. Image 3 is the approved style reference ONLY: do not copy any bus imagery, words or extra controls.
Composition: one compact horizontal row, landscape wide image on a pure white #FFFFFF canvas. Content in one line, left to right: slate ascending-priority-bars icon; 「作業-11」; small outlined circular half-progress status icon in forest green; 「利用者の声を整理する」; flexible space; white fine-outline pill with green dot 「調査」; white fine-outline pill with green dot 「礼拝改善」; slate dotted-outline assignee/person glyph; 「4月1日」. Preserve ALL these contents exactly. Preserve the source preview's relative column positions and text hierarchy, the title Regular rather than bold. No added title, table headers, cards, extra rows, metrics, action buttons or controls. Do not copy original English words or original AS-11 identifier. The original's long project badge was omitted in the saved Japanese mock; do not invent its Japanese content.
Visual treatment: #FFFFFF outer and row surfaces; subtle neutral bottom divider and restrained soft downward shadow; very gentle rounded row edges only, no nested card. Supporting icons #526173, title #1D1D1D, metadata #6E6E6E. Adapt original yellow progress to forest-green #1F6444 to match the established Japanese state; category dots stay green as in the Japanese mock. Keep white chips without mint fills. No decorative icon colors. No primary action exists, so do not invent a gradient button merely to demonstrate the style. Type must look like Meiryo Regular: body 14/24px, metadata 12/16px with zero tracking at the source's 960px logical width; preserve relative scale if output is larger. Sharp complete Japanese glyphs and numerals. Compact readable composition, aligned baselines, coherent stroke weight, no clipping. Raster design candidate only.
reviewNotes: 原画像全体・個別切抜き・日本語モック・正式バス方向を実見。元の黄色進行状態を既存緑へ統一、分類は白チップと緑点、補助アイコンはスレート。日本語と作業-11/4月1日、必要な列を保持。余白が過大で文字がモックより太く、コンパクトな納品構図と書体照合は要修正。元の長いプロジェクトバッジは日本語モックに無く内容未創作。画像候補のみ、所有者承認・新規ネイティブ・アプリ実装ではない。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
